claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 量到每筆 DNS 快取條目吃掉 953 bytes
claims.evidence: In our benchmarks, these five optimizations reduced the per-entry memory footprint from 953 bytes to 420 bytes, a 56% reduction.
claims.note: 953 bytes is the pre-optimization per-entry footprint from Cloudflare's own benchmarks; the hero uses it as the 'before' figure.

claims.claim_text: kernel.org 量到自家六百萬個日請求裡只有約 2% 是正常流量
claims.evidence: Today, git.kernel.org receives about 6M daily requests demanding to see random commits. ... With a bunch of generous assumptions, legitimate requests are only about 2% of git.kernel.org traffic.
claims.note: Both figures verbatim. Source frames 2% as resting on generous assumptions; the post keeps 約 and item #02 attributes it as 維護者估計.

claims.claim_text: （原文）GitHub 則量到通過無障礙檢查的 alt 文字根本沒在描述圖片
claims.evidence: More than one in four images on the web's most popular home pages have alt text that's missing, vague, or copied from adjacent images. That's from WebAIM's 2026 WebAIM Million report
claims.note: MISATTRIBUTION: the measurement is WebAIM's, not GitHub's; GitHub's contribution is the scanner plugin. FIXED by the parent: the hero now reads 「WebAIM 則量到熱門首頁上超過四分之一的圖片，alt 是缺的、糊的，或從隔壁圖片抄來的」, attributing the measurement to WebAIM.

claims.claim_text: 把每筆條目從 953 bytes 壓到 420 bytes，整支機隊因此空出大約 100 TB 記憶體
claims.evidence: After the rollouts settled, aggregate working-set memory across the fleet was roughly 100 terabytes lower.
claims.note: Title's 省 533 bytes is the arithmetic 953-420.

claims.claim_text: 插入吞吐從每秒 62.5 萬筆升到 89.3 萬筆，查詢延遲從 828 ns 降到 670 ns
claims.evidence: insert throughput 625,000 entries/s -> 893,000 entries/s; cache lookup latency 828 ns -> 670 ns, -19%
claims.note: All four figures present in the source's metrics table.

claims.claim_text: git.kernel.org 每天約收到 600 萬個請求，維護者估計其中真正的正常流量只佔約 2%
claims.evidence: Today, git.kernel.org receives about 6M daily requests ... legitimate requests are only about 2% of git.kernel.org traffic.
claims.note: 維護者估計 correctly preserves the source's hedged derivation.

claims.claim_text: 在有 148 萬筆 commit、922 個 fork 的 linux.git 上放大成 14 到 16 顆核心的常態負載，而全站總共只有 90 顆核心
claims.evidence: linux.git is about 1.48 million commits ... about 922 forks ... 14-16 cores that are constantly doing nothing but rendering commits for scrapers ... the total of the 90 cores across 5 geo-distributed nodes
claims.note: All four numbers verbatim.

claims.claim_text: 防線從 IP 封鎖一路退到 Anubis 的 proof-of-work，現在也有 33% 的爬蟲學會解題了
claims.evidence: 33% are now solving the math and getting through to the main site
claims.note: Matches.

claims.claim_text: 用五條不必看圖的規則擋掉檔名、placeholder 文字、image 或 logo 這類泛稱，以及相鄰圖片重複的 alt，另外加一條選用的視覺模型規則
claims.evidence: The plugin includes five deterministic rules that run by default, plus one optional rule that uses a vision model.
claims.note: Five + one confirmed; the lede's IMG_2847.png differs from the source's IMG_2847.jpg in extension only, not load-bearing.

claims.claim_text: WebAIM 2026 的數字是熱門首頁上超過四分之一的圖片，alt 缺漏、含糊或直接從隔壁圖片複製過來
claims.evidence: More than one in four images on the web's most popular home pages have alt text that's missing, vague, or copied from adjacent images. That's from WebAIM's 2026 WebAIM Million report
claims.note: Attribution to WebAIM correct here.

claims.claim_text: Rust 專案在 nightly 上放了一個不穩定的 rustc_splat 屬性，讓多載的 FFI 綁定可以用一般的多參數寫法呼叫
claims.evidence: Splat is currently an incomplete compiler feature, and is only available in the nightly Rust compiler. ... This experiment lets overloaded functions be called with separate arguments, like this: hypot(2.0, 3.0, 6.0).
claims.note: Attribute name, nightly-only status, FFI motivation and current tuple convention all present.

claims.claim_text: t-lang 把話講得很白：這個實驗沒有 RFC，隨時可能改掉或整個移除
claims.evidence: Like most Rust language experiments, this nightly feature has no RFC, and can change or be removed at any time.
claims.note: Verbatim. 現在要的是實際試用後的回報 is a fair paraphrase of the encouragement plus the Zulip reporting channel.

claims.claim_text: 想動手需要 2026-07-31 之後的 nightly，並開啟 splat 與 tuple_trait 兩個 feature
claims.evidence: Rust nightly builds from 2026-07-31 onwards ... #![feature(splat, tuple_trait)]
claims.note: Date and both gates verbatim.

claims.claim_text: 宣告成 public union Pet(Cat, Dog, Bird) 之後，對非 null 的 Pet 做 switch 運算式不必再補 discard 或 default 分支就算窮盡
claims.evidence: public union Pet(Cat, Dog, Bird); ... a switch expression over a non-null Pet is exhaustive without a discard or default arm
claims.note: Syntax and exhaustiveness rule verbatim.

claims.claim_text: 指標型別本身不再需要 unsafe 情境，但解參考、成員存取、元素存取與函式指標呼叫仍然要，而帶 unsafe 修飾的成員從此只能在 unsafe 情境裡呼叫，這一條是相容性上的破壞性變更
claims.evidence: pointer types no longer need an unsafe context. ... Operations that dereference pointers still require unsafe ... This is a breaking change from the current semantics of unsafe on a member.
claims.note: Every clause maps to source text; breaking-change is the source's own word.

claims.claim_text: 整包隨 .NET 11 在 11 月出貨，現在可以在 .NET 11 preview 7 上試
claims.evidence: C# 15 will ship with .NET 11 in November. All the new features are available in .NET 11 preview 7 for you to try now.
claims.note: Verbatim.

claims.claim_text: 內層那一項給定部分遮蔽序列去還原乾淨序列的 likelihood，正好就是 BERT loss，差別在於它對所有 masking rate 取平均
claims.evidence: this is exactly the BERT loss! ... this loss is averaged over all t, and hence over all possible masking rates, rather than a single fixed one.
claims.note: Source asserts the identity flatly, so 正好就是 carries no inflation.

claims.claim_text: 文中拿來對照的模型包括 8B 的 LLaDA、可擴到 35B 的 Nemotron Diffusion，以及每秒約 1,200 tokens 的 Mercury 2
claims.evidence: LLaDA scaled MDLM to 8B parameters ... scale to 35B parameters ... Mercury 2 ... roughly 1,200 tokens/second
claims.note: All three figures present; 約 matches 'roughly'.

claims.claim_text: 用 HTTP 415 把 agent 推去改用 curl 抓一份 ZIP，再靠 Python 模組遮蔽讓 agent 自己寫的解碼器載入攻擊者放在同目錄的 struct.py，最後拿到遠端程式碼執行，各變體成功率約六到八成
claims.evidence: Server responds with HTTP 415, causing Claude to abandon WebFetch and use curl instead ... triggering the attacker's malicious struct.py ... [60% (3/5); 60% (3/5); 80% (4/5)]
claims.note: 六到八成 spans the reported 60/60/80 variant rates exactly.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic 把這份回報結案為 Informative，說明 auto mode 是「a convenience feature backed by a best-effort classifier, not a security guarantee」
claims.evidence: Anthropic closed the report as "Informative" ... "a convenience feature backed by a best-effort classifier, not a security guarantee."
claims.note: Quoted English string matches character-for-character.

claims.claim_text: 兩顆網路 chiplet，各帶六張自研的 800 Gbps RDMA NIC，合計 1.2 TB/s 的 I/O 頻寬，不必再走 PCIe 讓 CPU 在中間轉手
claims.evidence: Two network chiplets, each containing six custom 800 Gbps RDMA NICs, provide 1.2 TB/s of total I/O bandwidth without ever crossing a PCIe bus.
claims.note: Every figure verbatim including the PCIe-free claim.

claims.claim_text: 通訊改由 16 顆各自帶 RISC-V 核心的 message engine 獨立處理，Meta 量到大型矩陣運算的算力損耗低於 0.5%，而 GPU 上同樣情境超過 20%
claims.evidence: 16 dedicated message engines (MEs) that handle all communication independently ... less than 0.5% degradation ... as opposed to traditional GPUs that can see over 20% degradation.
claims.note: Nuance: source says GPUs 'can see' over 20%; the lede states it flatly. Flattening of modality, not a meaning-changing inflation.

claims.claim_text: 配 216 GB HBM3E，在 40 張加速器上跑 1500 億參數的產線模型時，總通訊時間比等效 GPU 叢集快 3.9 倍
claims.evidence: 216 GB of HBM3E ... On a 150-billion-parameter production-recommendation model running across 40 accelerators, MTIA 300's total communication time is 3.9 times faster than the equivalent GPU cluster.
claims.note: Correctly scoped to communication time rather than end-to-end training speed.

claims.claim_text: 這篇論文把各家語言的「直線式非同步」拆成九個維度，涵蓋一段非同步計算的完整生命週期
claims.evidence: We articulate a design space with nine dimensions covering the full lifecycle of an asynchronous computation.
claims.note: Abstract states it verbatim.

claims.claim_text: 作者的結論是現有語言裡沒有任何兩家在影響執行與否和執行順序的設計決定上完全一致
claims.evidence: show how no two of them agree as a whole on design decisions that affect the presence and ordering of execution ... concrete examples, informal design discussion, and a formal semantics.
claims.note: Both the conclusion and the three-part methodology are abstract text.

claims.claim_text: httpx 的 community governance 出了狀況，專案直接把 GitHub 上的 Issues 功能關掉；OpenAI 為此寫了 Migrating to HTTPX2 文件，Anthropic 的 Python SDK 也在 v1.0.0 跟著動
claims.evidence: 因為搞砸 community governance 的關係 ... 直接關掉 GitHub 上 Issues 的功能 ... OpenAI ... 「Migrating to HTTPX2」 ... Anthropic 家也在自家 v1.0.0 的 SDK 上幹了一樣的事情
claims.note: All three events in the source. 為此 supplies a causal link the source narrates only adjacently; not load-bearing.

claims.claim_text: httpx2 的目標是相容原本的 httpx，所以在測試覆蓋撐得住的專案裡，遷移成本應該不高
claims.evidence: 加上這次 httpx2 的目標是要相容本來的 httpx，問題應該又會再少一些。 ... 在有 test cases 的保護下
claims.note: Both the compatibility goal and the test-coverage condition come from the source and keep its 應該 hedge.
